consumption_module_declaration.why_not_native_episode: A direct program carries no native_episode block (the native-episode loader refuses one on any program that is not the native-role episode), so the declaration lives here and is proven by the byte proof rather than verified by the loader.

failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. No automatic restart, replay, row filtering, roster, prompt, geometry or cap change. AT MOST ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration per run id (a new generation attempt id); a second failure closes the cell and the fix is proven on a four-row dry run. A partial manifest is never scored and never read.

generation_budget.definition: The direct-only phase program makes exactly one contact per native window: 4 windows x 1. No fit identity (the direct baseline declares none, as the flown E35 direct arms). Ceilings, not targets; run-cumulative across attempts.

purpose: WIRE-CHECK-ONLY successor of earnings21-native-stage3-module-alloff-smoke-4-v1. Four-row form smoke of the evidence-consumption module's ALL-OFF arm on earnings: every component off, which compiles to the carrier's DIRECT layer. Earnings has no locked system: the six-node form flew once (item E35, STRUCTURAL PASS) and is NOT admitted (base lock v3 section 4; E39 / E41 are four-row form proofs). The E35 read names the DIRECT arm as the comparator, so the module's all-off arm is the direct baseline on the full discovery roster -- e21-native-window-direct-full44-v1, referenced byte for byte (it carries no fit identity). It is the carrier admission gate of design section 2b.3: the module-bare arm on the carrier's own roster before any component is turned on there. Own null: E21's measured own null (WER 0.058, PERSON 0.250, ORG 0.356, numeric 0.157; docs/results/2026-09-27-verdict-reclassification.md) was measured on the pre-FlightRuntime buf90 direct form (SAEA-E21-FULL44-NULL-REPLICATE-V1), NOT on these native-window bytes; the module null on this form is unmeasured until an in-chain A/A of this arm seals (design 2b.3). A FORM proof: it claims no benefit, admits nothing and compares no mechanism; no component-on cell exists for this carrier. Development numbers only (owner decisions 28 and 86).
